name: ajitta-socratic
description: Two portable Socratic skills from portable-skills/: a questioning-led brainstorm and Plato's elenchus. The SuperClaude framework itself is installed with the superclaude CLI, not from this marketplace.

plugins.name: socratic-brainstorm
plugins.description: Modern Socratic questioning (one question at a time) to test an idea, then your own options plus up to three labeled ones, convergence by criteria, and an honest verdict with a short brief.

plugins.name: socratic-elenchus
plugins.description: The method of Plato's early dialogues: what is X, premises you agree to, a contradiction built from them, and your revised definitions as the new ideas. Usually ends in aporia. No advice.
